node_01_crm.short_desc: Artron CRM is a multi-layered, dynamic database enabling unified digital management for all member types — from elite professional athletes to casual guests, family units, and corporate groups. The system automatically enforces legal and medical compliance, shielding your enterprise from liability.
node_01_crm.hint_chip_select: [ SELECT AN ACCORDION CHIP ON THE LEFT PANEL TO VIEW FULL TELEMETRY ]

sub_items.label: 1. Multi-Profile Hierarchy (Families, Parents & Children)
sub_items.functional_desc: Legal and financial linking of parent and child profiles within a unified ecosystem. Allows parents to manage memberships, wallets, and booking histories for dependents.
sub_items.permissions: Club administrators can delegate full financial management rights to parents while restricting dependents to workout plans and check-ins.
sub_items.business_value: Simplifies launch of family subscription tiers, boosts LTV (Lifetime Value), and significantly increases customer retention.

sub_items.label: 2. Corporate Groups, Students & Friend Associations
sub_items.functional_desc: Centralized management of B2B corporate contracts, university partnerships, and group rates with automated invoicing and cap enforcement.
sub_items.permissions: Admin retains rights to restrict corporate visit hours, define usage caps, and automate monthly B2B telemetry reports.
sub_items.business_value: Unlocks a reliable B2B sales pipeline, ensures guaranteed upfront recurring revenue (MRR), and accelerates bulk onboarding.

sub_items.label: 3. Professional Athletes vs Amateur Fitness Members
sub_items.functional_desc: Strict segmentation of club members based on athletic goals. Pro athletes access advanced biometrics, while casual members enjoy streamlined onboarding.
sub_items.permissions: Coaches receive view-only access to assigned pro group telemetry and medical safety data under strict privacy governance.
sub_items.business_value: Maintains high athletic standards and elite coaching prestige without alienating mass fitness members.

sub_items.label: 4. VIP Members, Guests & Trial Visits
sub_items.functional_desc: Instant digital onboarding for single-day guests, VIP clientele, and trial visitors with temporary dynamic QR/NFC access keys.
sub_items.permissions: VIP members receive priority facility reservation rights; guest passes grant time-restricted 24-hour turnstile entry.
sub_items.business_value: Drives premium brand perception, elevates VIP retention, and increases trial-to-membership conversion by 35%.

sub_items.label: 5. Medical Validity & Legal Compliance (Compliance & Safety)
sub_items.functional_desc: Automated verification and tracking of Form 100 medical clearances, liability waivers, and digital consent signatures.
sub_items.permissions: System automatically revokes facility turnstile and booking privileges if medical clearance or waiver expires.
sub_items.business_value: Protects club management from legal liability and financial penalties while reducing insurance risk exposure by 80%.
